description: This file defines the configuration data structures for the Swabble project, including nested structs for audio, wake, hook, logging, transcripts, and speech settings. It also includes a default path for configuration file storage, as well as loader functions to load and save configuration data from/to a JSON file.

methods.name: load(at:)
methods.description: Loads a SwabbleConfig object from a specified file URL, throwing an error if the file does not exist or decoding fails.

methods.name: save(_:at:)
methods.description: Saves a SwabbleConfig object to a specified file URL, creating necessary directories.
